allow_ports.description: Whitelist of allowed port mappings. Each entry: 'port:protocol[:ip[:internal_port]]'. Wildcards (*), e.g., '*:tcp'.

deny_ports.description: Blacklist of port mappings. Higher precedence than allow list. Same format as allow_ports.

enable_ipv6.description: Enable IPv6 support (requires IPv6-enabled kernel and compiled miniupnpd).

enable_natpmp.description: Enable NAT-PMP (legacy NAT mapping protocol). Disable unless required by legacy clients.

enable_pcp.description: Enable Port Control Protocol (PCP) for advanced NAT traversal.

enable_upnp.description: Enable UPnP Internet Gateway Device (IGD) service.

external_iface.description: Network interface used for external (WAN) traffic (e.g., PPPoE, cable, DSL).

friendly_name.description: Human-readable name shown in UPnP control points.

ifname.description: Exact name of the external interface (must match system interface name). Required for iptables rules.

igd_device_type.description: UPnP device type string (IGDv1 or IGDv2). Change only for compatibility.

incremental_lease_update.description: Write lease file incrementally on changes instead of full rewrite (safer for flash storage).

internal_ifaces.description: List of internal (LAN) interfaces with optional network CIDR. Supports multiple LANs.

lease_file.description: Path to persistent lease file for dynamic port mappings. Set to '' to disable persistence.

log_syslog.description: Log to syslog in addition to file.

logfile.description: Path to log file (empty = no file logging).

presentation_url.description: Web UI URL advertised via UPnP for gateway management. Set to '' to disable.

secure_mode.description: Only allow port forwarding rules from internal IPs. Prevents rogue external port mapping attempts.

serial.description: Device serial number for UPnP identification.

ssdp_alive_time.description: Time (seconds) before SSDP entries expire and require re-broadcast.

system_update.description: Interval in seconds between SSDP system-update notifications. Set to 0 to disable.

upnp_port_max.description: Maximum external port allowed in port mappings (0 = no limit).

upnp_port_min.description: Minimum external port allowed in port mappings (0 = no limit).

uuid.description: Unique device identifier (UPnP UUID format). Leave empty for auto-generate.
